description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver for WorldSemi WS2812B individually-addressable LEDs using SPI interface.

classes.name: ws2812b_led
classes.description: Represents a multicolor LED with subleds and cascade index.

classes.name: ws2812b_priv
classes.description: Private data structure for the driver, including SPI device, mutex, LED data buffer, and array of ws2812b_led.

methods.name: ws2812b_set_byte
methods.description: Converts a byte of data into 3-byte SPI data for WS2812B pulses.

methods.name: ws2812b_set
methods.description: Sets the brightness of an LED by preparing SPI data and transmitting it.

methods.name: ws2812b_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates resources, and registers LEDs based on device tree nodes.
